name: Entur Geocoding
description: Forward geocoding, autocomplete, reverse geocoding, and NSR-backed transit-stop suggestions for Norway

entur-geocoder.purpose: Search places, addresses, POIs and stops, reverse geocode coordinates, and resolve exact native IDs through Entur Geocoder v3
entur-geocoder.dataSent: Search text, coordinates (longitude, latitude), exact native IDs for place lookup, language, result limit, optional lowercase ISO2 country, multimodal mode, and ET-Client-Name header
entur-geocoder.dataReceived: Native GeoJSON features with structured names and addresses, coordinates, native IDs, categories, stop types, transport modes, descriptions and supplier identity

entur-geocoder-nsr.purpose: Supply Entur National Stop Register geocoder data through Entur Geocoder v3
entur-geocoder-nsr.dataSent: No direct request to this dataset supplier; search text, coordinates or exact native IDs and filters are sent to Entur's API
entur-geocoder-nsr.dataReceived: Native features supplied by Entur National Stop Register geocoder data, with names, coordinates, identifiers and available structured metadata
